priority_dimensions.why: Strict compliance with SEBI and AMFI norms, along with authorized NSE/BSE commercial redistribution licensing, is a non-negotiable legal requirement to prevent client liability.
Exchange commercial redistribution licensing fees are notoriously expensive and could easily overwhelm the startup's ₹3–5 lakh/month budget.
Ingesting 20+ years of historical OHLCV and real-time tick feeds into TimescaleDB and Kafka requires highly structured, clean, and reliable APIs.
The hard deadline of 8 weeks for staging and 3 months for production means typical vendor onboarding lag could jeopardize the entire product roadmap.
Many market data contracts restrict retaining historical data after termination, creating a severe vendor lock-in risk for proprietary analytics.
